metadata.title: Real-mode multi-region active/active HA (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: Customer-facing REST tier spans East US and West Europe with shared Cosmos data; writes accepted in both regions during normal operations.
technologyStack: Azure Traffic Manager (fallback not primary path)
reviewObjectives: Validate conflict resolution and data correctness guards
Confirm blast-radius containment during regional degradation
Review cost of dual active footprints vs RTO requirements
constraints: RTO target 15 minutes; RPO target 5 minutes for cart state
EU privacy requires EU data residency subset; US traffic stays in US endpoints only
Cosmos conflict resolution policies require clinical audit when merge rules fire

inputSummary: Front Door fronted active/active API tiers with Cosmos multi-region writes and explicit conflict policies. Distinct from corpus-real-mode-multi-region (no-DR runbook case).

qualityEvidence.notes: Committed Topology exemplar; complements corpus-real-mode-multi-region (DR gap / runbook stress).
